purpose: Every site in the cleared artifact where a reference to an authority producer is handed off (stored in an object or array, returned, captured by an arrow, aliased, spread or passed). Any new site is REFERENCE_ESCAPE_DRIFT. A site inside a fingerprinted function or a module-level statement is bound by the baseline. Outside those, a site is PRIMITIVE_MEMBER (the path ends at a primitive literal in the declarator), READ_ONLY_ALIAS (nothing is written through the alias in that function), FROZEN_BINDING_SHALLOW (the binding is Object.freeze-d; nested members may not be), or NEEDS_REVIEW (listed for human disposition). The automatic dispositions are author analysis and also need review.
